newsitem.title: FINLAND: "Brain gymnastics" help in Finnish classrooms.
newsitem.headline: "Brain gymnastics" help in Finnish classrooms.

text.p: Have a glass of water, rub your chest, stretch your left elbow towards your right knee, then stretch your right elbow towards your left knee: Finnish teachers are finding it helps children concentrate.

A school therapist said on Friday a coordinated experiment with regular "brain gymnastics" at a school in Lahti, southern Finland, has cut the time it takes one teacher's class to settle down to five minutes from 15.

Therapist Maija-Liisa Leppanen said by telephone that the exercises, based on so-called neuro-linguistic-programming, help the left and right hemispheres of the brain communicate and can be good for adults too.
"If you combine the exercise with thinking about your objectives, the results can be very good," Leppanen said.
So stand up. Cross your hands and pull them towards your chest, cross your feet, raise your eyes and stand still, with both eyes focused on the ceiling. Feel better?
